welcome.lead: We are absolutely thrilled that you're going to be part of the 4th Annual Home Care Champions Experience!
body: This is your official home and hub. Everything you need will live right here.
We are back in San Diego at Yard and Sea, and we cannot wait to do it all again with you.
Speakers, the agenda, and everything else will land on this page as they are confirmed. Bookmark it now, because when we announce, this is where it shows up first.

In the meantime, the dates are locked and the travel and accommodations details are already here, so you can start planning your trip. September is a beautiful time to be in San Diego, so make a proper trip out of it.
